hack.root_cause: DNS Hijack / Front-End Attack (Router Address Substitution)
hack.description: Mad Meerkat Finance lost $2M to a DNS attack that silently swapped the router address in their front-end for 3 hours, rerouting 600+ user transactions to the attacker while Discord users raising red flags were ignored by the team.
